name: text-melt-drip
title: Melt Drip
description: Phần dưới của chữ chảy dài xuống như sáp nóng, mỗi chữ một nhịp, từ vệt dài nhất một giọt rơi xuống.

moworks.author: moworks

options.spread: s the letters start within, in a seeded order (0.5)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Per char (seeded order, starts spread over 0.5 s): the lower half (baseline − 0.3 to + 0.26 em) stretches down per column by melt × (8 + 58 × noise(x·0.11)^1.8) px, melt 0 → 1 over 1.6 s easeInQuad (SVG: Y displacement 0 → 40 px, 2 s, spline (.55,0,1,.45), turbulence 0.02 / 0.15); tops pinned; gooey alpha (blur 4, alpha ×18 −7); Each char sheds one accent drop from its longest drip: swells 0.25 s, falls y = 220·t² px. Reset 3.0–3.5 s; loop 3.8 s. Params: drip: độ dài vệt chảy (8–66 px) · duration: mỗi chữ (1.6–2 s, ease-in) · spread: lệch giữa các chữ (0.5 s) · drops (bật). The tops stay pinned; only the lower part of each column stretches down by melt × the drip length.
